acceptedRuntime.notes: 9a4ece9bf is the accepted fork head containing the iris_agent#51 framed JSONL entry+receipt journal (PI-019: versioned frame with monotonic seq + sha256 checksum, fsync durability boundary via FileSystem.syncFile, explicit supportsCrashRecoverableReceipts capability, torn-tail quarantine with typed diagnostics) PLUS both review-finding fixes: (1) the missing-newline torn-tail append guard (appends emit a missing newline first so a complete frame written before a torn tail is never concatenated into a quarantined line) and (2) the physical torn-tail repair (FileSystem.truncateFile truncates quarantined torn bytes on load so they can never become mid-file corruption after later appends). Prior accepted identity 18d059bf is an ancestor. acceptedRuntime is the single authoritative identity for the Pi runtime iris_agent is allowed to consume; floating main is never an accepted identity.
